name: Roger Federer
rankNote: retired legend; on the roster as Ryan's pick (Nov 9 2026), not in the live top 20
era: peak headband era, about 2004–2012 (white headband, short tousled dark hair). Earlier look, 2001: short ponytail with a headband or bandana and a bead necklace, worn when he beat Sampras at Wimbledon
signature: the white headband over short, tousled dark hair, plus a smooth, upright one-handed backhand; looks calm and almost effortless
exaggerate: bright white headband, a little thicker than real, with hair flopping over it

upright, relaxed posture; light, gliding footwork (no grunting, few big gestures)
